scope: Local isolated workerd + persistent D1; synthetic tools; no production deployment or model evaluation.

checks.name: LangGraph interrupt stores the validated harness state
other owner and case cannot read an existing run
parallel failure follows one successful sibling execution
checkpoint history contains a connected parent chain
failed superstep persists the successful sibling output
restored in a new Worker process
interrupted state retains identical structure and values after termination
resume payload cannot inject fact confirmation
resume completes without re-running the prepared step
a completed run cannot be resumed twice
fresh business revision prevents a stale checkpoint from completing
pending writes recover without re-executing the successful sibling
thread deletion is isolated by owner and case
